svg.title: ZKRoto 0.2 - 01 source view
svg.text: exported walk01_FRA-007 f000123: openpose\src, mediapipe\src, zkroto
Person 1 blue / 2 orange (as in 0.1): the one POV and
Export use. Selected = solid, the other faded.
Swap = exchange 1 and 2 in this frame (MediaPipe does
not keep who is who between frames); saved in zkroto.
View switch Source | POV | Split (key V).
source camera (default on) = also the clip's own angle.
shot (e.g. walk01) + character (e.g. FRA-007); empty shot = clip.
numbered = new in 0.2 (yellow border on new controls)
Unchanged: load, fps, frame steps, Pose (P). Capture (C): same, but saved in ZKRoto\capture\<clip>\.
